contract: contract.md: shared Pantiss login and all four authenticated workspaces; actual logo, shared section chooser, protected existing API, responsive sidebar/tables/editors.

accessibility.evidence: Browser checks: empty required password focuses the input; incorrect password is linked by aria-describedby=auth-login-error and aria-invalid=true; Tab reaches Show password with a visible solid outline; native dialog Escape now restores focus to Add job posting. Real logo decoded. Muted token contrast increased in both themes; reduced-motion uses existing important transition override.

responsive.evidence: Rendered login and tenders workspace at 1280x720 and 390x844. Mobile document scrollWidth equals 390. Desktop sidebar becomes horizontally scrollable mobile navigation; tables scroll within their container. Long tender titles wrap. Mobile submit measures 56px high. Two-column desktop editor keeps Save draft within 720px viewport.

loading.evidence: Observed Signing in… with password, section chooser and submit disabled during the mock login request.

empty.evidence: Submitting an empty password produced native required validation and focused the input. A no-matching-test-result search displayed No matching items with a recovery suggestion.

error.evidence: Incorrect mock password displayed Incorrect password.; input aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby points to auth-login-error. A correct password then succeeded.

partial.evidence: Disconnected-storage fixture kept section navigation available and displayed an administrator-directed connection message without empty counts or editing actions.

success.evidence: Selected Tenders before signing in with disposable mock credentials; browser navigated to /admin/tenders and displayed records. Theme persisted when switching to Job postings. Sign-out returned to the shared login with Job postings selected.

permission.evidence: authConfigured=false fixture displayed the contact-administrator message and disabled the password and submit controls.

renderedEvidence.observation: Shared login with real logo, all four functional destinations and a compact sign-in form.
Mobile login with real logo, two-column destination chooser and submit visible without horizontal overflow.
Tenders workspace: sidebar, real logo header, summary cards, searchable table and status toggles with long titles.
Mobile workspace: compact navigation and summary cards; table contained within a horizontal scroll area.
Two-column job editor with scrollable fields and visible Save draft and Cancel actions.
Authenticated partial-configuration state gives a clear recovery instruction.
